notes: All figures verbatim from Apple 10-K filings fetched from SEC EDGAR (primary documents: aapl-20210925.htm, aapl-20220924.htm, aapl-20230930.htm, aapl-20240928.htm, aapl-20250927.htm). Money in US$ millions. Category name is 'Wearables, Home and Accessories' in all five filings including FY2025 (as filed). Apple's five reportable segments are geographic: Americas, Europe (includes India, Middle East, Africa), Greater China (China mainland, Hong Kong, Taiwan), Japan, Rest of Asia Pacific. FY2023 was a 53-week fiscal year (ended Sep 30, 2023); the other four are 52-week years. Per the FY2025 10-K, Services net sales include amortization of the deferred value of services bundled in the sales price of certain products; per FY2021/FY2022 10-Ks, Products net sales include amortization of deferred value of unspecified software upgrade rights. FY2024 and FY2023 values were cross-verified across two filings (comparative columns in the FY2025 and FY2023 10-Ks respectively) and are consistent; grand totals (e.g., FY2025 $416,161M) tie between the category and segment tables.
